description: Get detailed variant information with optional sections. Core data (id, gene, rsid, significance) is always returned at the top level. Use sections to request additional data.

id.description: Variant ID (rsid, HGVS, or ClinVar ID)

sections.description: Sections to include: core, frequency, predictions, clinical, alphagenome_scores (currently unavailable — returns an error stub pending AlphaGenome gRPC reimplementation)

name: variant_get
